origine_fr: 囗 dessine une enceinte fermée : faire le tour, entourer. Il se lit wéi, comme 围, dont il est la forme ancienne. On l'appelle 国字框 ou 方框 (围字框 pour la norme) ; il enclôt 回, 因 ou 国.
origine_en: 囗 draws a closed enclosure: to go round, to surround. It is read wéi, like 围, of which it is the old form. It is called 国字框 or 方框 (围字框 in the standard); it encloses 回, 因 or 国.
memo_fr: Plus grand que 口, il enferme ce qu'il entoure.
memo_en: Larger than 口, it closes around what it holds.

phrase.en: She has gone back to Beijing.
